[EN] Rhodos revealed some of the history of Northern Arun, while Paesyn tried a new tactic to make Zolyn like him.
[ES] Rhodos reveló parte de la historia del norte de Arun, mientras Paesyn probaba una nueva táctica para agradarle a Zolyn.

[EN] That the Khirians took us in speaks well for your work, . We needed the shelter.

This Rhodos fellow talks about things falling from the sky. Perhaps we can salvage Intrepid!

Maybe our mission won't fail.
[ES] Que los Khirians nos hayan acogido habla muy bien de tu trabajo, . Necesitábamos refugio.

Este tal Rhodos habla de cosas que caen del cielo. ¡Quizás podamos rescatar al Intrepid!

Tal vez nuestra misión no fracase.

[EN] Paesyn wants to talk to you if you have a moment.
[ES] Paesyn quiere hablar contigo si tienes un momento.

[EN] This is why I like you! You saved the day!

I've seen several pieces of Intrepid's wreckage. I'll check them over. Maybe impress Zolyn a bit. Get her to like me!

Since my poem didn't cheer her up, I drew a portrait of her. Could you deliver it? Please?
[ES] ¡Por esto me agradas! ¡Salvaste el día!

He visto varias piezas de los restos del Intrepid. Las revisaré. ¡Tal vez impresione un poco a Zolyn y logre que le caiga bien!

Como mi poema no la animó, le hice un retrato. ¿Podrías entregárselo? ¿Por favor?

[EN] I heard you saved Madat. Not bad. You're a fine soldier."Paesyn drew this for you."
[ES] Me enteré de que salvaste a Madat. No está mal. Eres un buen soldado."Paesyn drew this for you."

[EN] I take it back.

Stop wasting my time with this nonsense. What is with that silly engineer? Doesn't he have work to do?
[ES] Retiro lo dicho.

Deja de perder mi tiempo con esta tontería. ¿Qué le pasa a ese ingeniero tonto? ¿Acaso no tiene trabajo que hacer?

[EN] Have you seen where Paesyn went by any chance?"He's investigating the wreckage."
[ES] ¿Has visto a dónde fue Paesyn por casualidad?"He's investigating the wreckage."

[EN] Well, we must press on.
[ES] Bien, debemos seguir adelante.

[EN] The way ahead will not be easy. You are new to Val Oriyn, so hear our grim tale.
[ES] El camino por delante no será fácil. Eres nuevo en Val Oriyn, así que escucha nuestra sombría historia.

[EN] We, the Khirians, resist the archdevas, but most of my kind are enslaved. We refer to them as the Parthia.

They have a camp nearby, but I don't know if they'll let us pass without a fight."I'll talk to them."
[ES] Nosotros, los Khirians, nos oponemos a los archdevas, pero la mayor parte de mi gente está esclavizada. Nos referimos a ellos como los Parthia.

Tienen un campamento cerca, pero no sé si nos dejarán pasar sin luchar."I'll talk to them."

[EN] I hope diplomacy works for you.

Look for Pariya. The Parthia respect her, but be careful.

She's dangerous.
[ES] Espero que la diplomacia te funcione.

Busca a Pariya. Los Parthia la respetan, pero ten cuidado.

Es peligrosa.

[EN] Hatishna? You believe such a popori tale?

No one stands against Lord Dakuryon. You too shall kneel before him!
[ES] ¿Hatishna? ¿Crees semejante cuento de popori?

Nadie se enfrenta al Lord Dakuryon. ¡Tú también te arrodillarás ante él!

[EN] Oh, ! You're here? Great!

Did Zolyn like the picture? I worked for days on it. What did she say?"She didn't care for it."
[ES] ¡Oh, ! ¿Estás aquí? ¡Genial!

¿A Zolyn le gustó el dibujo? Trabajé en él durante días. ¿Qué dijo?"She didn't care for it."

[EN] She probably doesn't appreciate my abstract realism. I studied art for two days in Velika, so I know all about it.
[ES] Probablemente no aprecie mi realismo abstracto. Estudié arte durante dos días en Velika, así que sé todo al respecto.
